main_body: Lamp-post: a mushroom-dome lamp head (rows 0-10) over a glowing lantern window (rows 11-15), a thin pole (rows 19-35) and a dome base (rows 36-45)
top_band: At x=8, light grey rows 1-4 (L~148) sit over a mid-grey body, but the shading is diagonal. At x=11 rows 1-7 are one L=122 tone with no light band. The base has a 1-row light line at x=8 (row 36) and none at x=11.
evidence: The heads and base are drawn as domes shaded diagonally from top-left, not as a lighter top ellipse over a front face. The centre column reads as one continuous grey ramp, 122 then 95 then 53, with no distinct top-to-front step. The base top is only 1 row at the centre and the cap is not a clear ellipse plate. The thin pole is a plain front-on shaft. This reads as a front-view silhouette with highlight shading, which fails the column cap rule.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 12 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and 12 colours per tile against 17-20. Its grey ramp is about 5 steps with a small gold ramp. Dark edge pixels are 45% neutral, so the outline is mixed. Surfaces carry almost no grain or dots: the pole and dome faces are smooth bands. The flat-fill coverage figure (13%) matches the stall reference and is not the problem. The problem is the low colour count and the near-black outline pixels, which make it noticeably thinner than the roofed well and the stall.
